reason: The README describes an educational plugin centered on Socratic lessons, classroom generation, slide rendering, and interactive teaching widgets, with external OpenMAIC API integration and sandboxed content rendering.

summaries.zh: 这是一个将 OpenMAIC 课堂、幻灯片、互动小组件和苏格拉底式教学能力集成到 DeepSeek Harness 中的教育插件。
summaries.en: An educational plugin that integrates OpenMAIC classrooms, slides, interactive widgets, and Socratic teaching capabilities into DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Submits classroom-generation requests to the OpenMAIC external service
Polls asynchronous generation jobs and returns classroom links
Renders agent-authored slides, interactive widgets, and HTML teaching fragments
Provides a Socratic teaching skill that uses rendered educational materials
